procedure: Scan 0..25 deg at 0.1 deg spacing at 70 m/s; realized CLmax -> equivalent stall speed; multiply by 1.23 for approach proxy
tolerance_reason: Pre-existing 5 kt held-out approach acceptance; combines generic high-lift/1.23 control-concept approximation with informative planning value, not instrument rounding
authority: Manufacturer informative planning point; authoritative source, approximate modeled procedure
limitations: No measured dynamic stall or exact VAPP/VLS law. 1.23 factor is a generic A320 concept from FAA A320-231 account, engine variant differs. Single informative point does not validate the complete polar.
